subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
subcategory: Privacy Laws That Changed the World
title: Data Localization Laws
description: A quick, practical guide to Data Localization Laws.

hook.text: Russia says Russian data must stay in Russia. China says the same. India is considering it too.

buildup.text: Data localization laws require that citizens' data be stored on servers within the country's borders.

discovery.text: Governments argue localization protects sovereignty. Critics say it enables government access and surveillance.

twist.text: For authoritarian governments, keeping data local means keeping it within reach of their own security services.

climax.text: Data localization sounds like protection. In practice, it often means making surveillance easier for the state.

punchline.text: Keep data local. Easier for governments to access.

quiz.question: What is a common criticism of data localization laws?
options: They can make it easier for governments to surveil citizens' data
They cost too much for companies to implement
